record.context_brief: Combinatorial proof in gauge-theory partition formulas
record.original_question: Find a combinatorial proof of Corollary 5.2, which gives a closed formula for (1/n!) Σ_{λ⊢n} f_λ^2 Σ_{u∈λ} ∏_{j=0}^{r-1} (h_u^2 - j^2).

evidence.quote: Problem 5.3 Find a combinatorial proof for Cor. 5.2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. For a partition $\lambda = (\lambda_1 \geq \lambda_2 \geq \cdots) \vdash n$ with Young diagram $Y(\lambda)$, and a cell $u = (i,j) \in Y(\lambda)$, define the hook length
$$h_u(\lambda) = \lambda_i - j + \lambda'_j - i + 1,$$
where $\lambda'$ is the conjugate partition. Let $f^\lambda$ denote the number of standard Young tableaux of shape $\lambda$, equivalently
$$f^\lambda = \frac{n!}{\prod_{u\in Y(\lambda)} h_u(\lambda)}.$$
For each integer $r \geq 0$, define the symmetric polynomial in the squared hook lengths
$$g_r(\lambda) \;=\; \sum_{u\in Y(\lambda)} \prod_{j=0}^{r-1}\bigl(h_u(\lambda)^2 - j^2\bigr),$$
and the Plancherel average
$$\Phi_n^{(r)} \;=\; \frac{1}{n!}\sum_{\lambda\vdash n} (f^\lambda)^2 \, g_r(\lambda).$$

Known fact (algebraic). The quantity $\Phi_n^{(r)}$ is a polynomial in $n$ of degree $r+1$ with rational coefficients, given by an explicit closed-form expression. (For example, $\Phi_n^{(0)} = n$ and $\Phi_n^{(1)} = n(3n-1)/2$.) This closed form was established by an algebraic argument using symmetric-function identities and contents of partitions.

Problem. Provide a purely combinatorial (e.g. bijective or sign-reversing) proof of this closed-form identity for $\Phi_n^{(r)}$, valid for all integers $r \geq 0$ and $n \geq 1$. The proof should construct an explicit combinatorial interpretation of both sides of the identity in terms of pairs of standard Young tableaux of the same shape together with a distinguished cell carrying the weight $\prod_{j=0}^{r-1}(h_u^2 - j^2)$.
artifact.status_search_result: A search did not surface a published bijective/combinatorial proof specifically of Stanley's Corollary 5.2 closed formula for the Plancherel average of $\sum_u \prod_{j=0}^{r-1}(h_u^2 - j^2)$. Related work (Han's elementary proof of the Nekrasov–Okounkov formula and various generalizations) has produced combinatorial and analytic proofs of related identities, but none of the located sources claim to settle the requested combinatorial proof of this particular corollary. Status appears unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Some Combinatorial Properties of Hook Lengths, Contents, and Parts of Partitions
status_evidence.snippet: Stanley proves Phi_n(F) = (1/n!) sum_{lambda |- n} f_lambda^2 F(h_u^2: u in lambda) is polynomial in n; algebraic proof.
status_evidence.claim: The closed-form result was proved algebraically; the question of a combinatorial proof is posed as a problem.

status_evidence.title: The Nekrasov-Okounkov hook length formula: refinement, elementary proof, extension and applications (Han)
status_evidence.snippet: Han gives an elementary proof using Macdonald identities of related hook-squared identities, but not the specific Stanley Corollary 5.2 combinatorially.
status_evidence.claim: Related identities have elementary/analytic proofs, but no bijective proof of this specific closed form is announced.

status_evidence.title: Some Conjectures and Open Problems on Partition Hook Lengths (Han)
status_evidence.snippet: Han lists open problems on hook-length identities including ones derived from Stanley's framework.
status_evidence.claim: Combinatorial proofs of various Stanley-type hook identities remain listed as open problems.
